notes.text: See the value, shape the gradient, and follow the binding.
Color previews — view solid colors and gradients over a transparency checkerboard, with contrasting hex labels for solid colors.
Gradient editor — drag linear-gradient endpoints and stops, rotate the direction, edit brush geometry, and copy the current brush as XAML.
Binding editor — follow live values through a flow diagram with property completion, converter stages, errors, and return-flow testing.
MultiBinding — group inputs by source instance and open each child’s own flow diagram with independent converter, format, null and fallback settings.
Converter picker — select application, resource and standard Avalonia converters using the binding’s single-value or multi-value interface.
Thickness editor — edit four sides around a content rectangle, with Enter advancing to the next input.
Source links — open property attributes, property-element bindings and identifiable code assignments with the shared blue editor button.
Desktop display preview — starts hidden until selected; phone previews remain visible by default.
Binding indicators — direct XAML values no longer appear as bindings, and temporary binding edits no longer appear as animations.
Binding experiments — protect the original binding’s source from experiment values and restore reverse updates on reset.
Popup discovery — recover already-open popups on Avalonia versions that expose the open-popup lists.
